Cloudlist is a tool for listing Assets from multiple cloud providers.

Usage:
  cloudlist [flags]

Flags:
CONFIGURATION:
   -config string                cloudlist flag config file (default "/home/ctk/.config/cloudlist/config.yaml")
   -pc, -provider-config string  provider config file (default "/home/ctk/.config/cloudlist/provider-config.yaml")

   -ip                             display only ips in results
   -extended-metadata              enable extended metadata for providers
   -s, -service string[]           query and display results from given service (comma-separated) (default cloudfront,droplet,cloud-function,cloud-run,s3,publicip,containerinstances,frontdoor,ecs,loadbalancer,ingress,custom,gke,domain,apimanagement,apigatewayv2,lightsail,trafficmanager,containerapps,eks,consul,dns,functions,staticwebapps,route53,lambda,alb,compute,applicationgateway,aks,storage,nomad,deployments,domains,ec2,instance,apigateway,elb,app,vm,cdn,appservice,fastly,service)

UPDATE:
   -up, -update                 update cloudlist to latest version
   -duc, -disable-update-check  disable automatic cloudlist update check

OUTPUT:
   -o, -output string  output file to write results
   -json               write output in json format
   -version            display version of cloudlist
   -v                  display verbose output
   -silent             display only results in output
